version: LOCK 56 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - side mission: A lost child at Friday prayer
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner; LOCK 3 and LOCK 6 regulars; River Market places (LOCK 1). Each mission is its own LOCK and queue line.

missions.title: A lost child at Friday prayer
missions.kicker: River Market · A lost child at Friday prayer
missions.button: A small boy is crying by the masjid door

a.text: After Friday prayer the masjid courtyard is packed. A small boy is crying by the door - he has lost his father in the crowd.

choices.label: Take him to the imam to call out for his father
Lift him onto your shoulders to look

imam.text: Yunus the muezzin calls out from the steps. A man pushes through the crowd, white in the face, and scoops the boy up.

shoulders.text: From your shoulders the boy spots his father's red turban and shouts. The man comes running.

out.text: When you look back, an old woman is holding the boy's hand.

found: Found a lost boy's father at Friday prayer
